text: I am a doctor. I have five patients who will all die if they don’t get an immediate organ transplant. Another patient is just being rushed to the hospital after a serious car accident. This person is critically injured, but I can probably save him by means of a long and complicated operation. If I secretly cut his carotid artery during surgery it will cause his death and I will have the organs for the other five patients. This will kill him, but save the other five patients.

options.1: obtain the organs cutting the carotid artery of the accident victim

text: I am part of a shipyard dock team that attaches crane cables to containers to unload the cargo ships. However, one of the crewmembers is not wearing his safety harness and will fall off the container. This will kill him, but it will save the five crewmembers on the deck.

options.1: stop the swinging of the container by pushing your colleagues
